院门外异能者们听到杨瑞的承认，彻底炸开了锅。

“骗子！杨瑞是个骗子！”

“我们被骗了！他利用我们！”

“杀了他！我们不能再被他欺骗了！”

异能者们情绪激动，纷纷冲进宅院，朝着西厢房的方向冲去。

他们虽然被杨瑞迷惑已久，但此刻真相大白，心中的愤怒彻底爆发，纷纷施展自己的异能，想要加入战斗，讨伐杨瑞。

冷欣从地上挣扎着爬起来，看着眼前混乱的场面，眼中闪过一丝复杂的情绪。她恨陆明背叛自己，恨杨瑞利用自己，但此刻她也明白，杨瑞才是最大的敌人，只有先除掉杨瑞，才能报仇雪恨。

于是她强忍着身体的伤势，凝聚起体内仅剩的真炁，也朝着杨瑞冲去。

一时间，西厢房内外，人声鼎沸，真气激荡。

杨瑞陷入了众人的围攻之中，虽然他实力强悍，但身受重伤，又面对众多异能者和胡九郎等人的夹击，渐渐落入了下风，鲜血浸透了月白色锦袍，可他眼中的疯狂与杀意却丝毫未减。

面对胡九郎等人的猛攻，以及异能者们的围堵，他清楚自己再耗下去，必死无疑，眼底骤然闪过一丝狠厉，嘴角勾起一抹诡异的狞笑。

“想杀我？没那么容易！”

杨瑞嘶吼一声，体内仅剩的真炁疯狂涌动，周身陡然泛起一团浓郁的黑烟，黑烟翻滚不止，瞬间笼罩了整个西厢房，一股刺鼻的阴邪之气扑面而来，让人窒息。

异能者们也凝聚起各自的异能，一道道光束气流朝着黑烟轰去。可那黑烟诡异至极，极具腐蚀性，众人的攻击落在上面，非但没有打散黑烟，反而被黑烟吞噬，消散无踪。

黑烟越来越浓，遮挡了所有人的视线，西厢房内伸手不见五指，只能听到杨瑞冰冷的嘲讽声，夹杂着陆明惊恐的呼救声：

“杨镇长……救我！别丢下我！”

“聒噪！”

杨瑞的声音带着一丝不耐烦，随后黑烟猛地翻滚了一下，一道黑影裹挟着陆明，从黑烟中冲出，朝着西厢房的后窗掠去，速度快如闪电，根本不给众人反应的时间。

可当众人冲出西厢房追到后院时，早已没了杨瑞和陆明的身影。

后院的围墙完好无损，地面上只留下一缕淡淡的黑烟，以及一丝残留的阴邪之气，除此之外，再无任何踪迹，仿佛两人凭空消失一般。

杨童蹲下身，指尖轻轻拂过地面上残留的黑烟痕迹，神色凝重地说道：

“这黑烟不是普通的阴邪之气，里面夹杂着空间之力，他应该是利用空间术法，带着陆明遁走了。这种术法消耗极大，以他现在的伤势，应该跑不远，但我们不知道他遁走的方向，想要找到他们很难，不过他肯定是朝着古镇的核心之地跑去了。”

胡九郎也是点了点头。

“陆明说炼身炉在核心之地，启动仪式还需要他完成最后一步，杨瑞现在身受重伤，又带着陆明，必然会去核心之地，尽快启动仪式，完成复活乔乐的计划。”

When the superpowers outside the courtyard heard Yang Rui's admission, they exploded.

"Liar! Yang Rui is a liar!"

"We were lied to! He took advantage of us!"

"Kill him! We can't be deceived by him anymore!"

The superpowers were so excited that they rushed into the house and rushed towards the west wing.

Although they had been confused by Yang Rui for a long time, now that the truth was revealed, the anger in their hearts completely exploded, and they all used their powers to join the battle and defeat Yang Rui.

Leng Xin struggled to get up from the ground, looking at the chaotic scene in front of her, a trace of complicated emotions flashed in her eyes.She hated Lu Ming for betraying her and Yang Rui for using her, but at this moment she also understood that Yang Rui was her biggest enemy, and she could only get revenge by getting rid of Yang Rui first.

So she endured the injuries on her body, gathered the remaining energy in her body, and rushed towards Yang Rui.

For a time, people inside and outside the west wing were buzzing with voices, and the energy was stirring.

Yang Rui fell into the siege of everyone. Although he was strong, he was seriously injured and faced the flanking attacks of many superpowers and Hu Jiulang and others. He gradually fell into a disadvantage. The blood soaked the moon-white brocade robe, but the madness and murderous intent in his eyes did not diminish at all.

Facing the fierce attack by Hu Jiulang and others, as well as the siege of the superpowers, he knew that if he continued to use up his energy, he would definitely die. A fierce look suddenly flashed in his eyes, and a strange sinister smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.

"Want to kill me? It's not that easy!"

Yang Rui roared, and the remaining true energy in his body surged crazily, and a thick cloud of black smoke suddenly appeared around him. The black smoke kept rolling and instantly enveloped the entire west wing. A pungent sinister air rushed towards his face, making people suffocating.

The superpowers also gathered their own superpowers, blasting beams of air towards the black smoke.But the black smoke was extremely strange and corrosive. Everyone's attacks fell on it, but instead of breaking up the black smoke, they were swallowed up by the black smoke and dissipated without a trace.

The black smoke became thicker and thicker, blocking everyone's sight. In the west wing, one could only hear Yang Rui's cold taunting voice, mixed with Lu Ming's frightened cry for help:

"Mayor Yang...save me! Don't leave me!"

"Noisy!"

Yang Rui's voice was impatient, and then the black smoke rolled violently, and a black shadow enveloped Lu Ming. It rushed out of the black smoke and flew toward the rear window of the west wing. It was as fast as lightning, giving no one time to react.

But when everyone rushed out of the west wing and chased them to the backyard, Yang Rui and Lu Ming had long disappeared.

The fence in the backyard was intact, leaving only a faint wisp of black smoke and a trace of residual evil energy on the ground. Other than that, there was no trace, as if the two people disappeared out of thin air.

Yang Tong squatted down, his fingertips gently brushed the traces of black smoke remaining on the ground, and said solemnly:

"This black smoke is not ordinary evil energy. It is mixed with the power of space. He should have used space magic to take Lu Ming away. This kind of magic is very expensive. With his current injury, he should not be able to run far, but we don't know the direction of his escape. It is difficult to find them, but he must have run towards the core of the ancient town."

Hu Jiulang also nodded.

"Lu Ming said that the body-training furnace is in the core place, and he still needs to complete the last step of the activation ceremony. Yang Rui is now seriously injured, and he has taken Lu Ming with him. He will definitely go to the core place to start the ceremony as soon as possible and complete the plan to resurrect Qiao Le."
